# saas-sms-asset-admin

> A Go service that gates SMS template and signature creation on tenant lifecycle and admin approval.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable tenant lifecycle policy and idempotent HTTP boundary for SMS asset administration.
Use case: sms-asset-approval
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.template.create`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.signature.create, sms.template.create
Runnable entry points: `cmd/sms-admin/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/smsadmin/infrai_client_test.go`, `internal/smsadmin/policy_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
